name: qc-dao-firebase
description: Firestore security rules and their tests

scripts.test: node functions/securityDependencies/manage.mjs --verify --production . && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project qc-dao-rules-test "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=../scripts/test-reporter.mjs test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.preemulate: VITE_FIREBASE_USE_EMULATORS=true npm --prefix ../frontend run build && node scripts/local-hosting-config.mjs
scripts.emulate: node functions/securityDependencies/manage.mjs --verify --production . && firebase emulators:start --config firebase.local.json --only hosting,functions,firestore,auth,storage
